# RECORD OF ADVICE – SECTIONS 3 AND 4 ONLY

---

## 3. NEEDS ANALYSIS

**Motor Insurance – 2022 Toyota Land Cruiser 200 (Replacement Value R1,250,000)**

Client requires comprehensive motor cover for a high-value late-model vehicle used for personal purposes. Risk profile indicates standard urban and rural exposure with professional owner. Full comprehensive coverage is essential given asset value and replacement cost implications. Client's stated usage patterns and no reported high-risk activities support standard comprehensive rather than third-party fire and theft. Adequate loss of use cover and accidental damage protection are necessary given vehicle age and potential repair costs.

**Buildings Insurance – Replacement Value R3,200,000**

The insured property requires full replacement value cover reflecting current construction costs and material inflation. Risk profile assessment confirms standard residential property with no unusual exposures, high-risk modifications, or heritage restrictions. Given the substantial replacement value, client needs comprehensive cover including standard exclusions clearly understood. Adequate sum insured is critical to avoid underinsurance penalties and ensure full reinstatement capability post-loss.

**Contents Insurance – Declared Value R450,000**

Household contents require specified or unspecified cover within the declared sum insured. Risk profile indicates standard domestic furnishings, electronics, and personal effects. Client requires clarity on which items are individually specified versus part of the aggregate sum. Standard exclusions apply to high-risk items (cash, jewellery above standard limits). Cover should include accidental damage extension where available.

**All-Risk Extension (Personal Articles/Jewellery)**

If applicable, client may require extension for valuable personal items including jewellery, cameras, or sporting equipment to eliminate cover gaps and limit exposure under standard contents exclusions. Risk profile does not indicate collections or unusual valuables requiring specialist cover.

**Liability Protection**

Standard personal liability cover within buildings and contents bundles provides basic indemnity for third-party injury and property damage claims. Client's household composition and property size indicate standard exposure levels not requiring enhanced limits.

---

## 4. MARKET COMPARISON

**Santam Personal Lines – Annual Premium R38,400 (RECOMMENDED)**

Santam offers integrated personal lines bundling motor comprehensive, buildings, contents, and liability in a single policy structure. Premium reflects market-competitive rating for the risk profile presented. Excess structures are standardized at R5,000 motor comprehensive with optional buy-down available. Key inclusions: accidental damage to motor, new-for-old replacement on contents within limits, emergency accommodation up to R3,500 per day, 24-hour roadside assistance, and standard personal liability of R5 million. Santam maintains strong claims settlement ratings and network repair arrangements across major urban centres relevant to client location. Administrative efficiency through single provider reduces compliance burden for client and broker. Recommended as optimal balance of premium, cover breadth, and claims service reputation.

**OUTsurance Personal Lines – Annual Premium R41,200 (NOT RECOMMENDED)**

OUTsurance pricing positions 7.3% above Santam recommendation (R2,800 premium differential). Cover scope is broadly similar with comprehensive motor, buildings, contents, and liability bundled. Excess structures comparable at R5,000 motor comprehensive. Key inclusions mirror market standards including accidental damage, emergency accommodation, and roadside assistance. While OUTsurance maintains adequate claims infrastructure and service delivery, the higher annual premium cannot be justified to the client given equivalent cover scope and risk profile match. No material differentiation in exclusions, excess structures, or ancillary benefits sufficient to warrant the premium premium. Client interest in cost-effective cover makes this option unsuitable as primary recommendation.

**King Price Insurance – Annual Premium R36,800 (NOT RECOMMENDED)**

King Price offers the lowest annual premium (R2,600 saving versus Santam recommendation). However, this insurer presents material concerns regarding claims settlement reputation and dispute resolution outcomes. Industry commentary and complaints data indicate protracted claims assessment periods and contested liability determinations disproportionately affecting comprehensive motor and contents claims. Given the high asset values under consideration (motor R1.25m, buildings R3.2m), the claims handling reputation risk outweighs premium savings. Excess structures are marginally higher at R6,000 motor comprehensive. Cost advantage is negated by reputational risk and potential claims delays during critical reinstatement periods. Accordingly, King Price is not recommended despite premium competitiveness.

---

**END OF SECTIONS 3 AND 4**

# RECORD OF ADVICE: PERSONAL LINES INSURANCE
**Client:** Jacques Pretorius | **ID:** 7805125082083
**Date Prepared:** [Current Date] | **FSP Reference:** [FSP Registration Number]

---

## 5. PRODUCT RECOMMENDED

### 5.1 Recommended Insurer and Policy Details

**Insurer:** Santam Limited (Short-Term Insurance Company)
**Policy Type:** Personal Lines Combined Cover
**Annual Premium:** R38,400.00 (incl. applicable taxes and levies)
**Policy Commencement Date:** [As agreed with client]

### 5.2 Sum Insured Schedule

• **Motor Vehicle (Line 1):** 2022 Toyota Land Cruiser 200, VIN [to be confirmed], Sum Insured R1,250,000.00 (Agreed Value basis)

• **Buildings:** Sum Insured R3,200,000.00 (Replacement Value basis) – includes all permanent structures on the residential property

• **Contents:** Sum Insured R450,000.00 (Replacement Value basis) – includes furniture, fittings, household effects, and personal possessions within the residential property

### 5.3 Cover Type and Statutory Detail (Section 9(1) Disclosure)

**Motor Cover:**
• Comprehensive cover including collision, theft, malicious damage, fire, and third-party liability
• Third-party liability limit: Minimum R5,000,000.00 (statutory minimum)
• Own damage excess structure: R5,000.00 standard excess; R7,500.00 if claims-free discount forfeited in any 12-month period
• Liability excess: R2,500.00

**Buildings Cover:**
• All-risks cover including fire, theft, malicious damage, storm/weather, subsidence (if applicable), and public liability
• Standard excess: R2,500.00 per claim
• Increased excess: R5,000.00 for weather-related claims (hail, wind, flooding)

**Contents Cover:**
• All-risks cover within the home including theft, accidental damage (optional), fire, and malicious damage
• Standard excess: R2,000.00 per claim
• Accidental damage excess: R3,500.00 (if accidental damage cover selected)

### 5.4 Exclusions – Key Limitations

**Motor:**
• Loss or damage sustained whilst the vehicle is being used for any illegal purpose
• Damage arising from wear and tear, depreciation, or mechanical/electrical failure
• Claims arising from driving under the influence of alcohol/drugs (exceeding legal limits)
• Claims where the driver is not in possession of a valid driving license
• Unattended vehicle damage (unless caused by collision, theft, or malicious act)

**Buildings and Contents:**
• Loss arising from faulty workmanship, poor design, or structural defects (unless caused by insured peril)
• Damage from settlement, shrinkage, or ground heave
• Consequential loss, business interruption
• Loss or damage whilst the property is unoccupied for periods exceeding 30 consecutive days (or as specified in policy wording)
• Damage from pests, vermin, or fungal growth (unless resulting from an insured peril)
• Loss of rent or loss of use (unless additional cover purchased)

**All Sections:**
• Intentional damage or damage caused by the insured or family members
• Losses excluded by specific policy conditions or endorsements

### 5.5 Excess Structure Summary

• **Motor – Own Damage:** R5,000.00 standard
• **Motor – Third-Party Liability:** R2,500.00
• **Buildings:** R2,500.00 standard; R5,000.00 weather-related
• **Contents:** R2,000.00 standard; R3,500.00 accidental damage
• **Total excess applicable per incident:** Aggregate of motor or buildings/contents excess for that claim

### 5.6 SASRIA Cover (Sectional Title and Special Risks Insurance Association)

• **Status:** SASRIA cover is **included as standard** within Santam Personal Lines comprehensive motor cover, covering loss arising from civil unrest, riot, strike, malicious damage by crowds, or terrorism-related acts

• **SASRIA Excess (Motor):** R10,000.00 applies separately to SASRIA claims (in addition to own damage excess)

• **Buildings/Contents SASRIA:** Santam provides SASRIA alignment on buildings and contents through dedicated SASRIA endorsements; excess on SASRIA-related claims: R7,500.00

• **Limits:** SASRIA cover is capped at the Sum Insured for the applicable section; no sublimit unless specifically requested

• **Claims Procedure:** SASRIA claims are reported to Santam and assessed in conjunction with the SASRIA Association where applicable

### 5.7 Additional Benefits and Loadings

• **Roadside Assistance:** 24/7 breakdown cover for motor included
• **Legal Liability:** Third-party legal defense cost cover included
• **No Claims Discount (Motor):** Up to 45% discount available if claim-free history verified
• **Multi-policy Discount:** 5% combined discount applied for bundling motor, buildings, and contents
• **Security Device Discount:** 8% reduction if specified security devices installed (alarm, tracking, gate automation)

---

## 6. REMUNERATION AND CONFLICT OF INTEREST DECLARATION

### 6.1 Broker Remuneration Structure

• **Commission Model:** Santam Personal Lines commission paid by insurer to broker: **12% of annual premium** (R4,608.00 for this placement)

• **Basis:** Commission is earned once policy inception occurs and premium is settled; no additional fees charged to client

• **Santam Commission Comparison:**
  - OUTsurance: 12% (R4,944.00 on R41,200 premium)
  - King Price: 12% (R4,416.00 on R36,800 premium)

### 6.2 Conflict of Interest Declaration

**Disclosure of Potential Conflicts:**

• **Broker is FSP-registered representative** under a licensed Short-Term Insurance Broker entity, authorized to provide advice on personal lines policies across multiple insurers

• **Commission differential exists:** OUTsurance quote would yield R336.00 higher commission; King Price would yield R192.00 lower commission than Santam recommendation. **Broker confirms that remuneration difference did NOT influence the recommendation decision.**

• **Broker has no ownership interest** in any of the three insurers compared (Santam, OUTsurance, King Price)

• **No conditional commission arrangements** exist with Santam based on volume thresholds or performance targets that would create bias

• **Broker maintains professional independence** and recommends Santam based on objective criteria: premium competitiveness, claims service rating, product suitability, and overall value for the client's risk profile

### 6.3 Conflict Management Undertaken

• Risk profile analysis conducted **without reference to commission outcomes**
• Three independent quotations obtained from non-related insurers
• Recommendation documented **prior to commission calculation**
• Client explicitly informed of commission quantum and basis
• Client reserves right to decline recommendation without penalty

### 6.4 FSP Compliance Note

• This placement complies with FAIS Act 37 of 2002 Section 8 (duty to give appropriate advice) and Section 6A (duty to act in the interests of the client)
• Remuneration is disclosed fully in accordance with Board Notice 80 of 2003, Section 9(2)
• No undisclosed benefits received from third parties

---

## 7. REPLACEMENT ADVICE

### 7.1 Status of Replacement

**Replacement Status:** Not applicable – This is a **new policy placement**. The client currently has no existing personal lines insurance on record with the broker.

**Note:** If the client is replacing coverage from another insurer:
• Broker confirmation required from client on lapse dates of existing policies
• Notice of cancellation will be issued to previous insurer (if applicable) after client acceptance
• Broker will ensure continuous cover; no uninsured period will occur during transition
• Previous policy claims history will be reviewed for disclosure to Santam underwriting

---
